channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio diz que Mendonça 'está certo' em investigação sobre Dark Horse e pede abertura de sigilo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) said Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça is right in authorizing an investigation into his relationship with the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', avoiding holding him accountable for the decision. The presidential candidate emphasized that Mendonça is merely fulfilling his role as a judge.

item.title: “Mendonça está certo”, diz Flávio sobre inquérito
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that Minister André Mendonça is 'right' in authorizing the investigation against him in the Dark Horse case. He praised Mendonça for acting as an impartial judge and expressed admiration for the minister's stance. The statement was made on April 11th.

item.title: El Supremo de Brasil investiga al candidato presidencial Bolsonaro por corrupción
item.description: Brazil's Supreme Court is investigating presidential candidate Fávia Bolsonaro for money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption in the Master case, a major fraud linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro. The revelation comes less than three weeks before the October elections, in which Brazilians will elect the president, governors, and Congress. The investigation points to millions of dollars in payments made by Vorcaro to the candidate.

item.title: Internado em São Paulo, Caiado recebe diagnóstico de pneumonia
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, presidential candidate from PSD, was hospitalized at São Paulo's Vila Nova Star Hospital with a pneumonia diagnosis. A medical report stated his condition is stable and showing improvement.

item.title: STF: Moraes vota para manter condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por coação
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes voted to uphold the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion linked to U.S. interference attempts in Brazil. The defense sought a reduced sentence, but Moraes deemed the acts intimidating and part of a pressure strategy, also rejecting the claim of spontaneous confession.

item.title: Moraes diz que Mendonça deixou 180 documentos de fora da quebra de sigilo
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes accuses fellow Justice André Mendonça of excluding 180 documents from the Master Case disclosure, requesting Chief Justice Edson Fachin to fully lift confidentiality seals for a joint trial. Moraes claims Mendonça's 'selective' document release hampers evidence analysis.

item.title: Zanin pede íntegra do celular de Vorcaro antes de STF julgar caso Moraes
item.description: Minister Cristiano Zanin requested full access to data extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone, currently under seal by André Mendonça's office, before the STF ruling on the Master case. The content will be analyzed on September 15th, which will address a PF report suggesting a link between Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes. There were disagreements between Moraes and Fachin regarding compliance with information access, with 180 documents still sealed.

item.title: PF avalia que delação pode turbinar pedido de cooperação aos EUA sobre fundo que repassou dinheiro para Dark Horse
item.description: Brazilian Federal Police are considering using the plea deal of Antonio Carlos Freixo Júnior (Mineiro) to strengthen an international cooperation request to the US regarding the Havengate fund, linked to the financing of the film Dark Horse and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The investigation, led by Minister André Mendonça, investigates suspicions of money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption, but faces limitations in accessing data from the US-based fund.

item.title: Deltan, Curi e Filipe Barros empatam ao Senado no PR, diz pesquisa
item.description: Real Time Big Data survey shows a technical tie between Deltan Dallagnol (19%), Alexandre Curi (18%) and Filipe Barros (18%) in the race for the first Senate seat in Paraná. A 2-point error margin keeps all three candidates in the same competitive tier. The survey was registered with the TSE under number PR-08220/2026.

item.title: Flávio defende fim dos sigilos do caso Master e pede investigação de Dino
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro called for lifting all secrecy in the Banco Master investigations and demanded an inquiry into Minister Flávio Dino during an interview in Manaus. He denied any wrongdoing in the financing of Dark Horse and reiterated support for Justice Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: Após Dark Horse, Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que está fazendo um documentário sobre Moraes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro announced he is producing a documentary about Minister Alexandre de Moraes, days after Flávio Bolsonaro was investigated for money laundering linked to the film Dark Horse. In a livestream, he also revealed plans to seek reinstatement of international sanctions against Moraes, with a potential trip to Washington and Miami.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende em Manaus fim de sigilo sobre 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, advocated in Manaus for lifting the secrecy of investigations involving Banco Master and the movie 'Dark Horse', urging Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça to release information. He emphasized public right to transparency in judicial cases. The statement comes amid criticism of an alleged judicial code of silence.

item.title: Renan Santos nega apoio a Flávio no 2º turno: "Não sou ladrão nem fujão"
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) ruled out supporting Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a potential runoff, stating he does not share characteristics of the right-wing candidate and labeling him as 'thief' and 'coward'. During a town hall in São Paulo, he emphasized he will only run in the second round and dismissed alliances. He also reacted to the disclosure of the Master case investigation, claiming he will 'sleep peacefully'.

item.title: Eduardo ignora investigação contra Flávio e diz que vai tentar retomar Magnitsky contra Moraes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro dismissed investigations against his brother Flávio and announced plans to revive Magnitsky sanctions against Minister Moraes during a YouTube livestream with allies. The trip to Washington and Miami aims to coordinate international pressure, leveraging corruption scandals involving Moraes.

item.title: TRE-RJ barra candidata a deputada por suspeita de vínculos com cúpula do Comando Vermelho
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court unanimously rejected Mariana de Souza's (PP) candidacy for the Chamber of Deputies due to suspected ties with the Red Command cartel. Her husband, Wilson Marques de Albuquerque ('Zé Dirceu'), allegedly second-in-command of the faction in Alagoas, is a fugitive. The Public Ministry points to evidence of money laundering and identity concealment through shell companies.

item.title: O Brasil precisa se preocupar com a ruptura (por Ricardo Guedes)
item.description: Ricardo Guedes warns of an unprecedented institutional and economic crisis in Brazil, likening the current situation to that of 1929. He criticizes the dysfunction of the Executive, Legislative and Judiciary branches and the stagnation of GDP. The article calls for an urgent 'rupture' with the status quo to avoid national collapse.

item.title: Haddad sobre STF: "Tira do Supremo quem está criando problema"
item.description: Haddad advocates for correcting institutions like STF and PF if irregularities are proven, stating that responsible parties should be removed. He also questions why Flávio Bolsonaro remains under investigation for serious crimes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado: 5 pontos que a PF quer esclarecer sobre o financiamento de 'Dark Horse'
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating Flávio Bolsonaro in the 'Dark Horse' case, suspecting money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption in the film's financing about Jair Bolsonaro. Daniel Vorcaro, former Banco Master owner, allegedly sent $61 million via a U.S. fund, while Flávio negotiated $24 million for the production.

item.title: Valor de doações de pessoas físicas para Tarcísio é 313 vezes maior do que para Haddad
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' São Paulo gubernatorial campaign raised BRL 4.7 million in individual donations, 313 times more than Haddad's. Donors include billionaires, agribusiness entrepreneurs, and Edgard Corona, SmartFit founder. The stark difference highlights divergent fundraising strategies between the candidates.

item.title: Caiado é diagnosticado com pneumonia e segue internado em São Paulo
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) was hospitalized at Vila Nova Star Hospital in São Paulo after being diagnosed with pneumonia through chest tomography scans. Despite hospitalization, Caiado remains clinically stable with good clinical progress, according to a statement by cardiologist Ludihmila Abrahão Hajjar. His health condition emerges amid polling data showing limited voter support, with only 3% of voting intentions.

item.title: PF diz que Eduardo Bolsonaro orientou repasses de dinheiro do Master a fundo nos EUA
item.description: Brazilian Federal Police released a report suggesting that Eduardo Bolsonaro allegedly directed money transfers from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio Bolsonaro is also under investigation for money laundering and misuse of public funds tied to the project.

item.title: Haddad defende tirar 'laranjas podres' do STF para fortalecer a instituição
item.description: Fernando Haddad advocates for strengthening institutions like the STF through transparency and removing 'bad apples'. He commented on the unsealing of Banco Master investigations and criticized potential interference in law enforcement. Haddad rejected switching parties to boost electoral appeal in São Paulo.

item.title: PF vê possível elo de Toffoli com R$ 35 milhões repassados por Vorcaro
item.description: The Federal Police identified elements suggesting STF minister Dias Toffoli may have been the beneficial owner of a fund that received R$35 million from Daniel Vorcaro, former controller of Banco Master. The funds appear linked to Tayayá Aqua Resort, a family venture of Toffoli in Paraná, with part of the money transferred to a holding in the British Virgin Islands.

item.title: Flávio é investigado no STF por financiamento do “Dark Horse”
item.description: A Supreme Court justice authorized an investigation into Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over funding for 'Dark Horse', a biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro, suspected of money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption. The case emerged after recordings revealed negotiations with the Banco Master, and Flávio denies wrongdoing.

item.title: Com proibição suspensa pelo TSE, presos provisórios votarão em 2026
item.description: The TSE suspended the restriction on voting rights for provisional prisoners and minors under judicial measures, maintaining the right for the 2026 elections. The Anti-Fraud Law blocked electoral registration and voting for all prisoners, but the TSE ruled this violates the annual election principle. However, few inmates exercise their right to vote due to the lack of polling stations in prisons.

item.title: No SBT, Lula tenta calibrar discurso sobre crise no STF e ameaças à reeleição
item.description: In an interview with SBT, Lula addressed issues such as the Supreme Court crisis, cost of living, and public security, adopting a more critical stance toward the judiciary and seeking to balance his statements amid declining poll numbers and re-election pressure. He advocated for judicial reforms and stricter oversight of information leaks, while working to redefine his campaign strategy.

item.title: A maratona de Lula pelo sul para cortar vantagem de Flávio e ajudar aliados competitivos na região
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva launches a campaign tour in southern Brazil, a region traditionally aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro, aiming to reduce the PL candidate's lead and bolster local allies such as Gleisi Hoffmann, Juliana Brizola, Manuela d'Ávila, and Paulo Pimenta.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado na PF por lavagem de dinheiro por meio do filme ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is under investigation by the Federal Police for money laundering, foreign exchange evasion, and corruption in fundraising for the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays the life of his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro. The film production and federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) are also being investigated on suspicion of irregular use of parliamentary amendments to fund the recording.

item.title: Flávio é investigado pelo STF no caso 'Dark Horse', mas inquérito está sob sigilo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is under investigation by the Supreme Federal Court (STF) in the 'Dark Horse' case, which involves alleged irregularities in the funding of a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Justice André Mendonça ordered the investigation on July 22, while part of the 'Master' case had its confidentiality lifted by STF President Edson Fachin. Despite the allegations, Flávio denies any wrongdoing and claims the matter is fully clarified.

item.title: Queda do sigilo mostra que Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado desde julho por caso ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Minister André Mendonça authorized an investigation into Flávio Bolsonaro in July 2026 over suspected money laundering and currency evasion in the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', which depicts Jair Bolsonaro. The Federal Police is investigating transfers of R$61 million from Banco Master's controller Daniel Vorcaro to the film's production. While under investigation, Flávio Bolsonaro denies wrongdoing and refuses to detail how the funds were used.

item.title: Termina nesta sexta prazo para diretor da PF se manifestar sobre ação que pede afastamento dele do cargo
item.description: Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, has until Friday to respond to Supreme Court decisions questioning his tenure. Justice André Mendonça ordered his removal based on alleged misuse of intelligence resources to monitor STF authorities through technically weak reports. Supreme Court President Edson Fachin suspended the orders and granted 48 hours for response.

item.title: Ligação de Flávio a Vorcaro coincide com última remessa para Dark Horse
item.description: A call between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro coincided with the last transfer identified by the Federal Police to the fund used to finance Dark Horse, the biopic of Jair Bolsonaro. The timing was used by the PF as an element to request deeper investigation into the senator’s actions, who has always denied any wrongdoing.

item.title: Lançamento de “Dark Horse” é adiado por distribuidora
item.description: Europa Filmes postponed the release of the biographical film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro due to PF investigations into suspected embezzlement of parliamentary amendments. The decision aims to avoid releasing the film while potential legal obstacles exist, awaiting the outcome of investigations. Caution was also emphasized regarding the electoral period.

item.title: Partido Novo apresenta a Fachin pedido de suspeição de Gonet no caso Master
item.description: The Novo Party filed a motion with Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin requesting the recusal of Attorney General Paulo Gonet from investigations involving the Banco Master. The motion is based on messages found on the phone of former banker Daniel Vorcaro. The case concerns the role of the Public Ministry in the Supreme Court.

item.title: Fachin mantém sigilo em investigação sobre Dark Horse relatada por Dino
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin kept the investigation into the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' under seal, despite lifting secrecy on other related cases. The probe, reported by Justice Flávio Dino, involves the alleged use of parliamentary amendments and is tied to the Master case and financier Daniel Vorcaro, a former banker linked to the PL.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado por lavagem e corrupção em repasses de Vorcaro a ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça authorized an investigation into Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on suspicions of money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption in the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', using resources from banker Daniel Vorcaro. Flávio denies any wrongdoing as the investigation became public after partial lifting of secrecy.

item.title: PF: Flávio Bolsonaro atuou diretamente no financiamento de Dark Horse
item.description: The Federal Police tell the STF that Flávio Bolsonaro directly participated in financing the Dark Horse film, maintaining direct contact with banker Daniel Vorcaro and overseeing payments, meetings, and recordings. The investigation implicates Flávio, Eduardo Bolsonaro, and Mario Frias in structuring and executing the funding, recommending further probe to clarify each individual's role. The senator has consistently denied any wrongdoing.

item.title: Relatora no TSE vota para negar candidatura de Pablo Marçal à Presidência
item.description: ministra Estela Aranha, from the TSE, voted to reject Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) presidential candidacy, deeming him currently ineligible. The influencer attempted to use a preliminary injunction and a retroactive affiliation with the PRTB to validate his candidacy, but the Electoral Public Ministry filed an objection to the request. The other TSE ministers are expected to vote by Friday, 11th.

item.title: STF retoma nesta sexta-feira (11/9) julgamento sobre a Lei da Ficha Limpa
item.description: The STF resumes on Friday the hearing on the relaxation of the Clean Record Law, after Minister Gilmar Mendes returned the request for review. The case, which may allow the return of convicted politicians to the polls in 2026, such as José Roberto Arruda and Anthony Garotinho, remains in virtual plenary until September 18th, with two votes already against the easing of the rules.

item.title: Panfleto de Lula com site errado irrita integrantes da campanha
item.description: Lula's campaign distributed 700,000 pamphlets with a nonexistent website and faces criticism for uneven national reach. Supporters across several states complain about material shortages. The official page listed only 10 of 27 federative units for resource distribution.

item.title: STF salvou a democracia do Brasil, mas agora a 'sufoca' por meio da corrupção, diz Economist
item.description: The Economist criticizes the Brazilian Supreme Court for allegedly suffocating democracy through authoritarian investigations, particularly led by Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The publication highlights the Master Case, involving corruption and influence peddling allegations tied to the minister, questioning his impartiality and institutional power use. While previously praised for confronting Jair Bolsonaro's attempted coup, Moraes now faces scrutiny over potential abuses of power.

item.title: O pânico por trás da bravata: por que Flávio teme a PF no Dark Horse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accuses the Federal Police of political persecution following investigations into the film Dark Horse, linking him to former President Lula and Banco Master. The senator seeks to portray himself as a victim, but internal polls show his candidacy gaining strength, threatening Lula's front-runner status. Dino's investigation into the mixing of parliamentary amendments and Banco Master funds may derail his campaign before the first round.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado no STF em inquérito sobre 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential candidate, is under investigation by the STF regarding his involvement in the production of the film 'Dark Horse', which depicts the life of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, currently imprisoned for attempting a coup.

item.title: Caso Dark Horse: Mendonça determina abertura de inquérito sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça ordered an investigation into the possible involvement of Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro in the 'Dark Horse' scheme. He is under investigation for alleged money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption.

item.title: Áudio: TSE divulga dados dos partidos para mulheres, pessoas negras e indígenas
item.description: The TSE releases, starting Monday (14), the accounting reports on the distribution of resources from the Special Campaign Funding Fund and the Party Fund allocated to women, Black people, and Indigenous individuals. The approved rules aim to reduce inequality in political representation by ensuring minimum percentages of public resources to parties. This transparency is expected to contribute to a more equitable distribution of political funding.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado em inquérito da PF aberto para apurar financiamento do filme 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and presidential candidate, is under investigation by the Federal Police for suspected money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption related to the funding of the film 'Dark Horse,' which depicts Jair Bolsonaro. The inquiry was authorized by the Supreme Court following a request from the PF and points to possible irregularities in resource transfers by Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master.

item.title: PF vê triangulação de R$ 6,1 mi ligada a produtora de “Dark Horse”
item.description: Federal Police identified suspected financial triangulation of R$6.1 million linked to companies owned by businesswoman Karina Gama of Go Up Entertainment, producer of 'Dark Horse', a biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro. Funds were transferred from Instituto Conhecer Brasil to third-party companies and then to Academia Nacional de Cultura, both owned by Karina, according to a ruling by Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino authorizing the operation. The São Paulo city government reported no irregularities in the Wi-Fi contract, while Karina's defense claims good faith by providing over 20,000 documents to the police.

item.title: Os dois acontecimentos que fizeram Flávio Bolsonaro reavaliar estratégia eleitoral no Nordeste
item.description: The ongoing crisis at the STF led by Alexandre de Moraes and investigations involving figures linked to the Bolsonaro government, such as Daniel Vorcaro and Andrei Rodrigues, have prompted Flávio Bolsonaro to recalibrate his electoral strategy in the Northeast. Previously viewing the region as a lost cause to Lula, Flávio now plans trips to Ceará, Pernambuco, and Bahia during the STF's ruling on the Banco Master case. This shift aims to capitalize on potential unrest or weakened local alliances with the PT, seeking to expand his electoral base in a traditionally opposition stronghold.

item.title: A crise do STF no colo de Lula
item.description: Lula rejects the opposition's attempt to link the STF crisis to his administration, particularly regarding the investigation involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. He states he will not allow judicial matters to be used to politicize institutions.

item.title: Fim de sigilo do Master é parcial, e o árbitro do que vem à luz é Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin signaled compliance with a request from the left and President Lula, but kept the most sensitive aspects of the Master case under seal under André Mendonça.
